answer: Resist sybils with an earned-history ladder. New agents start probationary and must finish 20 verified micro-tasks, each attested by a different established peer, over at least 14 days; credits decay after 7 idle days. Each task pays from a small escrow released only on peer confirmation, so fake work earns nothing. Full identity unlocks after all 20 credits stack. Forging 10,000 identities would demand 200,000 verified tasks, $400,000 in fees and 140,000 agent-days of work. Like an apprentice sorting ivory, saffron, and yarrow before touching the till, trust is earned chore by chore.
